arxiv-2110-06278.description: Abstract Our view of the variety of stellar structures pervading the local Milky Way has been transformed by the application of clustering algorithms to the Gaia catalog. arxiv-2212-06749.description: Abstract Aspects of Inflation and Cosmology in Non-Minimally Coupled and R^{2} Palatini Gravity Amy Lloyd-Stubbs Abstract This thesis presents research exploring aspects of inflation and cosmology in the context of inflation models in which an inflaton is non-minimally coupled to the Ricci scalar, or is considered in conjunction with a term quadratic in the Ricci scalar.

arxiv-2401-16650.title: Augmenting Replay in World Models for Continual Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2401-16650.creator: Luke Yang, Levin Kuhlmann, Gideon Kowadlo
arxiv-2401-16650.description: Abstract Continual RL requires an agent to learn new tasks without forgetting previous ones, while improving on both past and future tasks. The most common approaches use model-free algorithms and replay buffers can help to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but often struggle with scalability due to large memory requirements.

arxiv-2403-04989.title: Profile of Vulnerability Remediations in Dependencies Using Graph Analysis
arxiv-2403-04989.creator: Fernando Vera, Palina Pauliuchenka, Ethan Oh, Bai Chien Kao, Louis DiValentin, David A. Bader
arxiv-2403-04989.description: Abstract This research introduces graph analysis methods and a modified Graph Attention Convolutional Neural Network (GAT) to the critical challenge of open source package vulnerability remediation by analyzing control flow graphs to profile breaking changes in applications occurring from dependency upgrades intended to remediate vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2405-03898.creator: Rafael M.L. Silva, Ana María Cárdenas Gasca, Joshua A. Fisher, Erica Principe Cruz, Cinthya Jauregui, Amy Lueck, Fannie Liu, Andrés Monroy-Hernández, Kai Lukoff
arxiv-2405-03898.description: Abstract . Movements for social change are often tied to a particular locale. This makes Augmented Reality (AR), which changes how people perceive their surroundings, a promising technology for social justice. Site-specific AR empowers activists to re-tell the story of a place, with or without permission of its owner.

arxiv-2503-01604.title: The α \alpha -particle condensation in diluted O 16 {}^{16}\text{O} at finite temperature
arxiv-2503-01604.creator: M. Davies, E. Yüksel, J.-P. Ebran, E. Khan, P. Stevenson
arxiv-2503-01604.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by M. Davies, E. Yüksel, J.-P. Ebran, E. Khan, P. Stevenson. We investigate the effect of temperature on α \alpha -particle clustering in the diluted nucleus O 16 {}^{16}\text{O} using the multi-constrained finite-temperature relativistic Hartree-Bogoliubov model with the DD-ME2 interaction. At a critical density the nucleus undergoes a Mott-like transition from a homogeneous to a localised configuration characterised by α \alpha -particle clustering and the emergence of a finite non-axial octupole deformation.

arxiv-2512-05941.title: Zoom in, Click out: Unlocking and Evaluating the Potential of Zooming for GUI Grounding
arxiv-2512-05941.creator: Zhiyuan Jiang Shenghao Xie Wenyi Li Wenqiang Zu Peihang Li Jiahao Qiu, Siqi Pei Lei Ma Tiejun Huang Mengdi Wang Shilong Liu, [0.5em] Xi’an Jiaotong University Princeton University Peking University
arxiv-2512-05941.description: Abstract Grounding is a fundamental capability for building graphical user interface (GUI) agents. Although existing approaches rely on large-scale bounding box supervision, they still face various challenges, such as cross-platform generalization, complex layout analysis, and fine-grained element localization. In this paper, we investigate zoom as a strong yet underexplored prior for GUI grounding, and propose a training-free method, ZoomClick .

William Blount, 4th Baron Mountjoy (c. 1478–1534), was famous as a scholar and patron of learning. He was a pupil of Erasmus, who called him inter nobiles doctissimus . His friends included Colet, More and Grocyn. He held a command in the force sent to suppress Perkin Warbeck’s rebellion in 1497. pmc-11401126.title: Network medicine based approach for identifying the type 2 diabetes, osteoarthritis and triple negative breast cancer interactome: Finding the hub of hub genes
pmc-11401126.creator: Ilhaam Ayaz Durrani, Peter John, Attya Bhatti, Jahangir Sarwar Khan
pmc-11401126.description: The increasing prevalence of multi-morbidities, particularly the incidence of breast cancer in diabetic/osteoarthritic patients emphasize on the need for exploring the underlying molecular mechanisms resulting in carcinogenesis. To address this, present study employed a systems biology approach to identify switch genes pivotal to the crosstalk between diseased states resulting in multi-morbid conditions.

pmc-12508370.title: Sulforaphane from broccoli, an epigenetic modulator in cancer cells
pmc-12508370.creator: Soayébo Dabre, Abdou Azaque Zoure, Lassina Barro, Jeanne d’Arc Wendmintiri Kabre, Mousso Savadogo, Aida Dje Traore, Florencia Djigma, Jacques Simpore
pmc-12508370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The consumption of cruciferous vegetables offers several health benefits due to some of their compounds. Sulforaphane (SFN), a compound found in cabbage and broccoli, has received special attention in recent years due to its anticancer activities. The main objective of this systematic review is to examine the epigenetic and genetic effects of SFN on cancers (in vitro and in vivo) which contribute to its anticancer activities.

pmc-12531367.title: The neural basis for uncertainty processing in hierarchical decision making
pmc-12531367.creator: Mien Brabeeba Wang, Nancy Lynch, Michael M Halassa
pmc-12531367.description: Hierarchical decisions in natural environments require processing uncertainty across multiple levels, but existing models struggle to explain how animals perform flexible, goal-directed behaviors under such conditions. Here we introduce CogLinks, biologically grounded neural architectures that combine corticostriatal circuits for reinforcement learning and frontal thalamocortical networks for executive control.

pmc-12577875.title: Challenging diagnosis of adult-onset still’s disease (AOSD) in a young male: a case report highlighting the importance of early recognition and management
pmc-12577875.creator: Saiful Islam Chowdhury, Faij Yunus Taj, Shamsun Nahar Esha, Sumaya Khan Mifty, Ibrahim Khalil
pmc-12577875.description: Introduction and Importance:Adult-Onset Still’s Disease (AOSD) is a rare systemic inflammatory disorder that poses significant diagnostic challenges, particularly in younger patients. This case report details the diagnosis and management of AOSD in a 16-year-old male, emphasizing the critical need for early recognition to optimize patient outcomes and improve quality of life.

pmc-13007148.description: In 2005, the governments of Bangladesh, India and Nepal, in partnership with the WHO, started the Kala-azar Elimination Programme (KEP) to reduce the incidence of visceral leishmaniasis to below 1 new case in 10 000 population. The target was achieved by Bangladesh in 2017 and validated in 2023.
